notes.title: Playstation VR2 Ready!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35934762/f2cbc59fa93e5839187e1c3e9f5bd93690e55ecf.jpg

Episode 00 is Playstation VR2 for PC ready.

More beautiful than ever on High res OLED !

Tested on 2080ti with Virtual link (No PC adapter needed) & ASUS USB-BT500  Bluetooth adapter.

Price is still 9.99$ I know it's a little expensive for today standards, but this is the best way to support a solo Indie Dev.
Volcanic Core development is still ongoing.
Thank you for your support!


In the last few years 2 music video were released:

- Story Episode X #03 - “Particle Moon” by Hidetoshi Koizumi
https://vimeo.com/684997007

- Story Episode X #04 - “In Yonder Glade” by Toshiyuki Yasuda feat. Seika Iwashita
https://vimeo.com/682105457
https://youtu.be/3Ocz02UuvU8?si=UeSvdDO_82iqW8jx
